source: Five unrelated stock menu templates in one PDF. Uploaded by Sam on 1 Aug 2026; page 3 produced zero items and six dishes were lost. No customer data — these are design templates, so they are safe to commit.
covers: every item on a page priced identically
an item page styled exactly like a cover (the incident)
handwritten script with '99.-' pricing and no currency symbol
dense four-category layout on one page
notes: Expectations were written by reading the printed pages at 300 dpi, NOT by copying parser output. Prices on page 4 use the continental convention where the dash stands in for the cents: '99.-' is ninety-nine dollars.

pages.note: Landscape, three columns, six headings. Every dish is $12.00 — real, and a trap for any 'all prices identical looks wrong' heuristic.

THE INCIDENT. Giant MENU wordmark, welcome sentence, six circular food photos, phone/address footer — reads as a cover, but carries six priced dishes. Also prints BURGER three times at two different prices, which name-only dedupe collapsed to one row.
Handwritten script set on curves, prices as '99.-' with no currency symbol.
Landscape, four headings, 28 rows. The densest page in the corpus.
